name: Molecular Biophysics PhD
detailsNote: Annual deadline; Fall 2027 date and admission model not confirmed on opened pages. Jenkins Biophysics merged into this program.

applicationFee.note: Documented qualifying affiliation, department request or hardship evidence in application. No nationality restriction stated; international applicants should confirm eligibility.

english.note: KSAS prefers TOEFL100 or IELTS7, not universal hard minima; scores under two years. Degree exemption requires two full-time years in US/listed country, requested in application; English instruction elsewhere alone insufficient.

requirements.note: Select Biophysics under Arts and Sciences. Biological/physical science, engineering and mathematics backgrounds encouraged.

funding.note: Five years guaranteed tuition, stipend/salary and medical/dental/vision premium coverage under collective agreement. 2026–2027 pay not Fall 2027 promise. Two semesters teaching required.
